text:
Priya: Heads-up — nightly bench (crons/bench-suite) failed around 00:12 on shard-3. CI is red; I see a couple flakes + an OOM in the logs. https://ci.redwood.local/job/12345
Tom: I saw that too. Looks like the test that allocates the large tensor blows memory intermittently. Can someone kick a rerun? @Kevin? :wave:
Kevin: on it, rerunning now. If it flaps again we should try a reduced-batch experiment and capture mem metrics. Saving logs as I go.
ci-bot: Re-run queued by Kevin — job id 789012; started.
Priya: attaching the OOM snippet that showed up in the logs:
```text
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Requested 12.3GiB
  at /workspace/bench/runner.py:412
  allocation size: 132456789 bytes
```
Tom: that allocation matches yesterday's spike on shard-3. @Marta did any autoscaler or config roll happen around midnight?
Marta: nope, no autoscaler changes. I did push a tiny change to the bench harness at 23:45 that tweaks prefetch behavior (PR #274). Could be related.
Priya: noted. If the rerun fails again let's do a quick bisect between the two container images (pre-PR vs current). Plan: run the same job with image v1.14 (prechange) and with latest, same shard.
Priya: bisect commands (copy/paste):
```bash
# rerun with old tag
ci rerun --job 12345 --image redwood/bench:v1.14 --shard 3
# rerun with current
ci rerun --job 12345 --image redwood/bench:latest --shard 3
```
Kevin: rerun finished — it passed this time. I also captured memory telemetry and uploaded it: s3://redwood-debug/bench/1722468100/metrics.json
Tom: cool, might be a transient allocation pattern. Priya — can you open a follow-up issue to revert or add guardrails for prefetch? If bisect later shows regression we can revert the harness change. Otherwise add mem-guard and a flaky tag.
Priya: will open an issue + PR to add a mem-guard and a short note in the bench runbook. If bisect ends up necessary I'll run it and post results. For now marking as resolved. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: job 789012 marked as passed.
